verdict.rationale: Porting is a fair question for a business phone platform like Quo, so the axis applies. The pack only mentions porting a number in ("One new or ported phone number... per user") and a cancel-anytime trial. Neither shows port-out without fees or in-app access to the account number or PIN a gaining carrier needs.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
